name: key-map
note: ADR-D01.74 outside sample mode: F1 keeps the palette route and leaves the key map hidden; Shift+/ over Local pins the key map, whose header names the key set and the place; the Key set row names every key it gave another meaning and the map marks them until it is closed; an unknown set is refused with the sets' names; no name takes the next set. The last wait keeps the window open for the foreground check.
